summary: Lead research for Rennick Market MVP (local food market/e-commerce for meat/produce). Targets local food producers, farmers markets, and direct-to-consumer agriculture businesses in Ashtabula County. Rennick Meat Market is an established butcher shop/restaurant in Ashtabula Harbor.

leads.fit_rationale: Established butcher-inspired steakhouse in Ashtabula Harbor. Could benefit from online ordering, reservation system, and local producer marketplace features.

leads.organization: Harbor Gardens (Local Food Market & Demonstration Kitchen)
leads.fit_rationale: Community-focused food market selling sustainably grown local products. An online marketplace with producer profiles would expand their reach.
Coordinates multiple farmers markets and maintains a local food guide with 95+ farms. Digital marketplace tools would support their mission.
Maintains directory of Farm Bureau members selling direct to consumers. An e-commerce platform would help members reach more buyers.
Directory connecting consumers with local farms. Features like online ordering, CSA management, and producer profiles would enhance the platform.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add producer profile pages with photos, story, and product listings.
Include online ordering with pickup/delivery scheduling.
Create a local food map showing farm locations and market days.
Add seasonality calendar showing what's fresh when.
Integrate CSA share signup and management.
Provide recipe suggestions based on available seasonal products.
Add loyalty program for repeat local food buyers.

possible_issues: Food market sites need appetizing photography—poor image quality hurts sales.
Without clear product categorization, shoppers may struggle to find items.
Missing local/regional branding may fail to differentiate from generic marketplaces.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Local food market platform can be white-labeled for individual farms, farmers markets, or regional food hubs with custom branding.
